data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 3,340.2m. During 2021 there was a net prior-year release of GBP 67.7m (gross), driven by favourable reserve development in the Insurance and Reinsurance divisions (including releases in Cargo, Marine Liability, Commercial Property and Financial Lines) which were partially offset by significant adverse development in discontinued lines (notably US trucking liability and International Casualty). COVID-19, a series of 2021 natural catastrophe events (including Hurricane Ida and the Texas freeze Uri), and inflationary concerns were highlighted as material influences on reserves and future uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: Reserve releases of GBP 23.0 million in 2021 compare favourably to 2020 which saw a strengthening of GBP 12.0 million.
The claims ratio has reduced by 12%, largely driven by the absence of COVID losses in 2021.
Adverse reserve development totalled GBP 94.0 million in 2021 compared to releases of GBP 14.0 million in 2020.

The strengthening is predominantly driven by US trucking liability (GBP 33.0 million) and International Casualty (GBP 38.0 million) classes, which saw significant deterioration in the year, driven by adverse experience, changes to the development pattern and prior loss ratios.
The Syndicate has recorded net loss reserves (net of reinstatement premiums) of GBP 84.0 million in 2021.

In terms of COVID losses, the Syndicate has recorded gross best estimate losses of GBP 299.6.0 million (2020: GBP 229.0 million) and GBP 137.2.0 million net (2020: GBP 136.0 million) at 31 December 2021.
There remains considerable uncertainty as to the extent and duration of this environment, as well as its potential impact on future claims settlements.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement (gross -67.7m) taken from note 11(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (Insurance liabilities column). Some divisional and line-level movements quoted in the narrative are reported net or by division; where gross per-LOB movements were not provided, allocations were inferred and amounts left null. RITC and Part VII transfers are present in the report and may distort development analyses; the claims development triangle excludes the aggregated '2011 & prior' column as required.
